caption: The drawing depicts a round ceramic plate shown in both a top-down and side view. The plate features an illustration of an eagle with outstretched wings, perched atop a stylized, leafy plant with symmetrical foliage and red, yellow, and green hues. The eagle holds a red, white, and blue striped shield on its chest, and above the eagle, there is a banner with the text “LIBERTY FOR A. JACKSON.” The rim of the plate is encircled with text written in a decorative script. The background colors of the plate are primarily greenish-yellow with hints of brown around the edges, and the foliage of the plant displays red and yellow shades. The side view at the bottom shows the plate's profile, shaded in brown to indicate curvature. The drawing is signed "Yolande Delasser" in the lower right corner.
title: Pa. German Plate
